hero.title: Welcome to the Village Playground
hero.subtitle: VPG 2026 wasn’t the right next move. Stay tuned for what will emerge next.

about.title: About villaging
about.fallback: The Village Playground is a gathering for people exploring villaging — cultivating interdependent, high-trust relationships of mutual support and thrival. ~70+ attendees including families and children, hosted by the Village Network Playground crew.

cta.title: Ready to join us?
cta.subtitle: Registration takes about 15 minutes. Only your name and email are required — everything else is optional and editable anytime.
